name_en: # Organizations that hold events in the Area calendar, other than one district (Host: D5) or the Area's own meeting types. A Google Calendar entry names its host with a line Organizer: <name> (one line per host), using name_en, name_es or any name in also. Search engines then read the row as the event's organizer, with this official name and website, and the event page shows "Hosted by" with a link. Never a person: an A.A. member is never named as a host.

# name_en = the organization's own official name, as its website or flyer prints it. name_es = its own official Spanish name only; leave it empty when it has none (Spanish pages then show name_en; do not translate here). url = its own official website (https://…, its home page, not an event, flyer or ticket page). also = other names an Organizer: line may use, separated by ; (capitals, accents, punctuation and a leading "The" do not matter). checked = the day the row was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD). source = where the name and website were checked (for editors; not shown). A host that appears once, like a one-year host committee, needs no row: type its website after its name in the Organizer: line.
